descriptions.value: A validation issue was addressed with improved input sanitization. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. A malicious app may be able to break out of its sandbox.

descriptions.description: A malicious app may be able to break out of its sandbox

descriptions.value: An authorization issue was addressed with improved access control. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An application may be able to execute arbitrary code with system privileges.

descriptions.description: An application may be able to execute arbitrary code with system privileges

descriptions.value: The issue was addressed with improved checks. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination.

descriptions.description: An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination
